    Build gap-series (conditional-likelihood) panels

    dot-build_conditional_panels.Rd

    Internal worker for prepare_data_general(likelihood = "conditional").

    .build_conditional_panels(
  id_vec,
  t_vec,
  d_vec,
  X_mm,
  y_vec,
  W,
  treated_ids,
  L,
  post,
  treat_threshold = 0,
  mass_tol = 1e-06
)

    Arguments

    id_vec, t_vec, d_vec

    Unit id (character), time, and treatment vectors aligned with the rows of X_mm.

    X_mm

    Design matrix from f.X.

    y_vec

    Outcome vector.

    W

    Weights matrix (rownames unit ids, colnames treated ids).

    treated_ids

    Column names of W.

    L

    Number of pre-treatment periods (event times -L..-1).

    post

    Post event times (>= 0) defining the estimand.

    treat_threshold

    Values of d_vec above this count as treated.

    mass_tol

    Tolerance on sum(w) == 1 for each treated unit's donors.

    Value

    list with X_list, y_list, w_list, row_idx_list, X_idlist.
